opportunities.name: United one-way or roundtrip flight search
opportunities.description: Search United.com for flights by setting trip type, origin and destination airports, dates, and passenger count, then submit with Find flights. Recurs with different city pairs, dates, and passenger/cabin settings.
steps: Open united.com and stay on the Book > Flight tab.
Choose Roundtrip or One-way (and optionally tick Book with miles or Flexible dates).
Type the origin city into 'Flying from' and click the matching suggested airport.
Type the destination city into 'To' and click the matching suggestion (choose the 'All Airports' metro option for multi-airport cities such as New York or London).
Open the Dates picker, move forward or back through months with the arrow buttons, then click the departure date and, for roundtrip, the return date.
Open Travelers, press + or - for adults, children, or infants, then close the panel.
Optionally change the cabin in the Economy dropdown (e.g. Premium economy).
Click Find flights.
On the results page, click Select fare on the desired fare card.
parameters: optional flags: Book with miles, Flexible dates

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor restaurant search by destination with cuisine filter
opportunities.description: Find restaurants in a chosen city on Tripadvisor, then narrow results by ticking a cuisine or diet filter and applying it.
steps: Open tripadvisor.com and click the Restaurants category (or the Restaurants link on a destination page).
Click the 'Where to?' / Search box, type the destination, and click the matching location suggestion.
On the results page, expand the cuisine or dietary section with 'Show more' if the option is hidden.
Tick the desired cuisine or dietary checkbox (e.g. Italian, Indian, Kosher, Outdoor Seating).
Click Apply if the filter panel shows it; otherwise let the checkbox filter the list.

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search and booking
opportunities.description: Find and book event parking near a sports or concert venue by searching the venue, choosing an upcoming event, optionally setting filters, times, and sort order, then booking a lot.
steps: Open spothero.com and type the venue name into 'Search for parking'; click the matching venue suggestion.
In the venue Events modal, optionally click 'Select Event Date' and pick a day.
Click the desired event in the Upcoming Events list.
Optionally click Filter, tick a feature (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible), then click Show N Results.
Set Enter After and Exit Before times in the time comboboxes, then click Update Search.
Set the sort order (Sort by Distance or Sort by Price) if needed.
Click Book Now on the chosen parking lot.
